notes.title: FLASHOUT 3 now available on Steam!
notes.content:
https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans//42288247/d5bc1cecacf056cf0426c81cc909c9dd464bc0c2.gif

Hello all FLASHOUT fans!

We are delighted to inform, that the third and most explosive entry to the FLASHOUT franchise, FLASHOUT 3, is now live on Steam! 

That's right, and you can grab your copy 10% off! Don't miss this chance and join the competition! We hope you will enjoy the new game :).

Thank you for your support!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1761870

notes.title: Support of Steam Achievements added!
notes.content:
https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans//42288247/d5bc1cecacf056cf0426c81cc909c9dd464bc0c2.gif

Hello all FLASHOUT fans!

As you probably know, tomorrow we are releasing FLASHOUT 3, the most advanced and explosive addition to the FLASHOUT series. Nevertheless it doesn't mean we forgot about our FLASHOUT 3D:EE community, no Sirs! You requested, we delivered - yesterday we have uploaded an updated version of the game featuring Steam Achievements. We hope this small addition will give you even more motivation to complete the game. Oh, and last but not least - don't forget to wishlist FLASHOUT 3 and to check it out when it launches tomorrow! Thank you for your support!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1761870
